notes.title: Felix The Reaper Demo
notes.content:
[h1]Heyho everyone![/h1]

Play the complete first chapter and get a glimpse of what's in store for Felix!
Should you decide to upgrade to the full version of Felix The Reaper, you can keep on playing with the progress you made in the demo version.

With the release of the demo, we have also updated the game itself by fine-tuning some puzzles and polishing the game further. 

All the best,
Kong Orange and Daedalic Entertainment

notes.title: Official Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33668224/8a03b102bbc2da166558e686d77b7c52ec34cddf.png[/img]

We are proud to announce, that our lovely Felix is now actively "making deaths happen" on Steam and on Consoles. 

Felix The Reaper is a puzzle game in which players alter events to end the lives of humans as ordered by the Ministry of Death. Like all reapers, Felix can only move in the shadows, but thankfully he can change the direction of the sun and move objects in a snap to create a safe passage through increasingly devilish scenarios. Each destiny fulfilled gets Felix one step closer to his heart’s desire: Betty the Maiden from the Ministry of Life. 

This adventure features original music from multiple independent musicians, as well as an intricate in-game database on the art and representation of Death throughout history.

[previewyoutube=56ID1_DMWR8;full][/previewyoutube]

Key features:
[list]
[*] A wonderfully original puzzle adventure with uniquely challenging gameplay set in a beautifully colorful, gruesomely sweet world.
[*] Play as Felix, a loveable reaper with the heart of a dancer.
[*] Over 20 story levels with hardcore difficulty variants for each, plus bonus unlockable time trials.
[*] Choose your own tunes on Felix‘s Walkman from a variety of indie music artists.
[*] Watch Felix dance with exquisite moves developed by professional dancers.
[*] Experience a fantastic world inspired by and showcasing nearly 1,000 years of art and storytelling depicting Death across multiple cultures.
[/list]

So we strive to get to 50.000 wishlist entries before we launch the game on Steam! (see why below)

And we are insanely proud to announce, that we hit a beautiful milestone today:

5.000 wishlist entries on Steam now!!! Thank you so much!

And do Wishlist us NOW, if you haven't already done so!

GO RIGHT HERE:

👇👇👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/919410/Felix_The_Reaper/

___

And yeah, why do we want these entries?

Games are also a business, that shall allow our studio to release the next game too.

Raising wishlist entries now lowers risk of failure significantly and enables us to forecast sales to a certain extend.

Way to many game development teams struggle to reach the finishing line, with way too little time for PR, because the market is harsh, money is scarce and development in itself takes a lot of focus in a small team.

Best,

Esben Kjær Ravn - designer and producer of Felix The Reaper

notes.title: Concept Of Death!
notes.content:
Here's some deadly drops from the mind of Mikkel Maltesen. Mikkel is the lead artist behind Felix himself and the world of the game overall. He is a big Miyazaki and Adventure Time fan.

Now he has started sharing some of his concepts for the game [url=https://www.felixthereaper.com/concepts] HERE. [/url]

But we thought we should also share a few tasters in here too, so here goes.

[h1]The Televator[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668224/c4c319a4b68599af93573feced8af3bc815352c1.gif[/img]
[i]Felix works at The Ministry of Death and as a field reaper he is a regular user of this clever contraption. It's an elevator that can teleport you into any given critical frozen split second in a human's life in order to end it according to plans and regulations. Hence it's a Televator.[/i]

[h1]1980´s New York[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668224/e715c09f21202eb80bbb4eeeec31862a52583f7c.jpg[/img]
[i]One of the worlds in the game is inspired by New York in the 1980's. In this chapter you'll meet an off off broadway down and out, who still rides a limo and has at least one fan. But that is all coming to an end obviously.[/i]


[b]GO WISHLIST US NOW IF YOU LIKE WHAT YOU SEE[/b]
